notes: Twenty-three approved Intellect skills: seven crafts and sixteen non-crafting skills.
Animal Lore deferred for later lore-system review; not approved or assigned.
Magical Inscription reserved for later design; not approved.
Concentration does not inherently enhance damage, Mana, or accuracy.
Tactics does not inherently grant extra attacks, damage, or Action Score.
Forging a document normally uses Intellect (Forgery), but specialized manual execution may permit an alternate attribute at GM discretion.

combatNotes: Dual Wielding is a Style Talent, not a Skill Talent.
One-handed weapons use Melee Weapons (Prowess); two-handed melee weapons use Heavy Weapons (Might).
Grappling and Unarmed Combat remain distinct Might skills.
Climbing is covered by Athletics (Might), not a separate Prowess skill.
Pickpocketing and Sleight of Hand are separate Prowess skills.
Ranged Weapons remains a broad Prowess skill; Throwing Weapons is separate.
Prowess already contributes to Dodge and Action Score; skill choices do not inherently increase either derived statistic.

notes: Use separate Talent, Expertise, and Mastery progression for each approved craft.
Preserve existing background-granted skill names when reviewing craft roster.
Do not treat background trades as automatically approved Intellect assignments.
